description: Add connection and search constants to api_constants.dart, then wire /connections route in app_router.dart to the new ConnectionsScreen instead of ComingSoonScreen.
steps:
2. Open web_app/lib/app/router/app_router.dart. Add this import after the last existing screen import:
   import '../../presentation/screens/connections/connections_screen.dart';
   Then replace the entire GoRoute for path: '/connections' with:
   GoRoute(
     path: '/connections',
     name: 'connections',
     builder: (_, __) => const ConnectionsScreen(),
   ),
   The ComingSoonScreen import line can remain since /notifications and /leaderboard still use it.
acceptance_criteria: api_constants.dart compiles with zero errors and contains all 7 new connection-related constants/methods.
app_router.dart imports ConnectionsScreen and routes /connections to it.
`flutter analyze` in web_app/ produces zero errors after these changes (the screen file must exist before analyze can pass — FEAT-002 creates it).
verification: After FEAT-002 is also complete: run `cd web_app && flutter analyze` — expect zero errors.
Run `cd web_app && flutter build web` — must succeed.
findings: Added 8 entries to ApiConstants: connections (const), connectionRequest, connectionsPendingReceived, connectionsPendingSent (static String fields), connectionAccept(id), connectionRemove(id), connectionStatus(userId) (static methods), and userProfile(id) (static method). Updated app_router.dart: added import for connections_screen.dart and replaced the /connections GoRoute builder from ComingSoonScreen to ConnectionsScreen. ComingSoonScreen import retained for /notifications and /leaderboard routes.
